name: Steal A DNA
desc:
🧬 Welcome to Steal A DNA!

How to Play:
🧬 Steal 2 dna from any animals
🔬Merge dna and make new animal
💰 Earn money from your animals
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and pen
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal dna from other players
✨ Discover rarer dna, animals, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, Tablet and TV players
